text: M20 `lxdrxdm2` / `ctxregst` treat a fixed command's `hint` as its visible trigger (`/section`) and measure a command-source item's collision against it. In the code `SlashCommand.hint` has always been an ARGUMENT hint (`anchor`, `type + slug`), and the visible trigger lives in `SlashCommand.label` (`/section`). Assumed: an item's `hint` is compared with the fixed command's `label` (slash, case and padding ignored), and the typed `/prefix` is matched against an item's `hint` the same way; fixed commands keep their existing id/label filter. The spec should either name `label` as the visible trigger of a fixed command, or the code's `hint`/`label` should be swapped in a brief of its own.
assumption: ASSUMPTION:dev-0302 — collision compares a source item's hint with the fixed command's label (src/client/tiptap/slashPalette.ts, fixedTrigger)
